messages:
Maya (CSM): FYI we just received the incident summary from eng. Small group of onboarding reindexes were throttled by an autoscaler bug between 10:07-10:34 PT. Affected: 7 onboarders (mix of trial and paid). Need coordinated comms + credits + reschedule workflow.
Ravi (CS Ops): Can you drop the list here? I will start drafting segmented emails for trials vs paid POCs.
Luis (Eng): Root cause: a defective health-check probe caused the horizontal scaler to evict warm workers during a rollout. Evictions led to transient ingestion failures and some jobs timed out. We paused the rollout at 10:34 PT and forced worker warmup; queues draining by 10:50 PT.
SRE Bot: Incident INC-2026-137 logged: autoscaler-eviction-reindex. Severity: P2.
Hannah (Onboarding): Who are the accounts? I have three scheduled orientation calls today and need to know if I should reschedule.
Maya (CSM): Accounts: NimbusAI, CartaLex, PaperKite, ForgeDocs, AtlasQuery, MeadowForms, SyntaxLabs. Prioritize NimbusAI and CartaLex for renewal risk.
Priya (Billing): If credits are required, what’s the proposed standard? Need a quick policy to approve provisional credits.
Ravi (CS Ops): Draft status note (short):
Ravi (CS Ops): "Hi <CustomerTeam>,

We observed a service disruption impacting onboarding reindex jobs between 10:07-10:34 PT today. Some imports were delayed or retried; our team has reprocessed the affected work and the remaining jobs are finishing now.

Werolled back the rollout that triggered the autoscaler behavior and added capacity to speed final processing. No customer data was exposed.

We will follow up with an RCA and account-specific remediation/credit offers. Your CSM will reach out to confirm any scheduling changes.

- Redwood Customer Success"

Hannah (Onboarding): Good signal. I'll hold NimbusAI's 2pm session for 30 min and then confirm. If they want, we can offer a make-good onboarding slot.
Luis (Eng): Engineering follow-up: full postmortem draft in 72 hours, final internal RCA in 96. Fixes: patch health-check, add warmup gate to autoscaler, add a pre-rollout smoke that simulates long-running reindexes.
Maya (CSM): For paid POCs recommend: "one-time account credit and priority requeue assistance". Keep amounts flexible; let billing coordinate exact values.
Priya (Billing): Approved provisional credits up to $2,000 per affected paid account pending final review. Will flag NimbusAI and CartaLex for expedited approval.
Ravi (CS Ops): Draft RCA note for paid POCs (short):
Ravi (CS Ops): "Hi <CustomerTeam>,

RCA summary: A health-check regression caused the autoscaler to evict warm workers, resulting in reindex timeouts for a subset of jobs. We detected and rolled back the rollout, requeued failed jobs, and added temporary capacity.

Mitigations: patch and gating deployed, additional alerting for requeue lag, postmortem coming in 72 hours. We will apply a one-time credit and offer a priority troubleshooting session if needed.

- Redwood CS Ops"

Maya (CSM): Please include ticket refs for requeued jobs when you send the status. Customers like to see evidence of what we reprocessed.
Luis (Eng): I'll export the requeue job IDs and paste them here in 10m.
SRE Bot: Validation run: requeues completed for 7/7 jobs at 10:49 PT. Two items retried twice; both succeeded.
Hannah (Onboarding): Outreach plan: Ill call AtlasQuery and MeadowForms first (they are session owners), send a follow-up note to PaperKite and ForgeDocs. Offer a "priority make-good slot" in our onboarding calendar.
Maya (CSM): I'll handle NimbusAI and CartaLex outreach. If either wants an executive check-in, escalate to me and I'll loop in Solutions.
Ravi (CS Ops): Owners: Maya -> NimbusAI, CartaLex; Hannah -> AtlasQuery, MeadowForms, PaperKite; Priya -> billing credits; Luis -> eng postmortem; Ravi -> outbound messages + ticket list.
Priya (Billing): Marked NimbusAI and CartaLex for provisional credits and sent a hold to finance.
Luis (Eng): Pasting requeue summary (brief): 7 job IDs requeued, all completed; median requeue latency 28s; root cause patch deployed to canary cluster.
Maya (CSM): For renewal-risk accounts: offer a free 1-hour onboarding health-check and early access to an upcoming performance workshop. Capture any sentiment/feedback.
Hannah (Onboarding): Adding a "post-incident feedback" checkbox to each onboarding ticket and will collect any unclear UX/errors reported by customers.
Ravi (CS Ops): Sending status email to all impacted customers now with ticket refs and CSM contacts.
SRE Bot: Incident status: mitigated (10:55 PT). Postmortem timeline updated: draft in 72h.
Maya (CSM): Thanks everyone. Please paste any customer replies here and tag me for escalations. I'll follow up after the postmortem is published.
